purpose: Reduce manual search for restored/delisted historical codes that Yahoo no longer serves directly.
candidate_rule: predecessor is missing from authoritative restored daily fetch
predecessor has an accepted JPX delisting event
successor candidate has a JPX listing event no earlier than one day before and no later than 10 calendar days after predecessor delisting
successor candidate is in the frozen current universe
Yahoo frozen current-code daily history exists before successor official listing date
interpretation: A row is only a shortlist clue that Yahoo may have stitched predecessor history into a successor code.
acceptance_requires: official JPX/company evidence that predecessor and successor represent the same economic/security continuity for the relevant dates
